comparisons.policy: a shared layer's GGUF indexer tensors are VALUE-identical copies of the preceding full layer's (indexer.proj is stored BF16 on shared layers and F32 on full layers in the BF16 build, so the proof compares decoded fp32 values, never container bytes); the HF model builds no indexer on a shared layer, so the copies are consumed as proven duplicates and never loaded

method: HTTP range requests against both repos (no shard downloads); GGUF dims reversed to row-major; BF16 compared as uint16 bit patterns; GGUF F32 tensors compared by requiring the F32 to be exactly representable in bf16 and then bitwise-equal to the official bf16
